manifest.description: Cybernetic work protocol for DSH: the session goal (dsh-goal) driven loop of task -> verify -> triage agents, implicitly advanced via one workflow run per round. Server plugin + client goal tab.

# dsh-cybernetics bundle patch: inserts the plugin row into the profile roster.
# Dual-face plugin by package name: the Node half (src/index.ts) provides the
# cybernetics tool and the system-prompt guidance; the browser half
# (exports["./client"], declared via dsh.client) renders the「目标 / Goal」tab.
#
# Optional config (override from a later layer, e.g. the profile patch):
#   - id: dsh-cybernetics
#     config:
#       roundsPerSubgoal: 3
#       implicitTrigger: true
#       roles:
#         default: { provider: zai-coding-cn, model: glm-5.3 }
#         verify:  { provider: zai-coding-cn, model: glm-5.3 }
#         writer:  { provider: zai-coding-cn, model: glm-5-turbo }
# Top-level insert: the client-module boot graph enumerates only top-level
# loader entries, so the Node half must load at the root for the「目标」tab to
# register. The workflowEngine service (published inside each Agent's preset
# delegation group) is NOT statically injected — apply() reads it per call via
# `ctx.agentPresets.serviceFor(agent, 'workflowEngine')`; see src/index.ts.
# History 2026-11-02: a top-level static inject of workflowEngine hung boot;
# mounting the whole plugin inside preset-standard silenced the client scan.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-cybernetics
      # The client-modules scan matches the loader entry name against the
      # package manifest name; after the @mars.liu rename the two must agree
      # or the browser half is silently skipped (tabs disappear).
      name: '@mars.liu/dsh-cybernetics'
      config:
        # v0.4 hard gate: restrict top-level session agents to read/control
        # tools at prompt-assembly time — every CHANGE must go through a
        # cybernetics goal + task agent. Task/verify/triage subagents unaffected.
        hardGate: true
        # allowlist mode: keep ONLY reads + conversation + control verbs
        # (built-in DEFAULT_GATE_ALLOWLIST); robust against the long tail of
        # mutation tools (farm_*, taskboard_*, knowledge_save, ...).
        gateMode: allowlist
        # v0.6 step 0: keep the team verbs so the session agent can breed a
        # persistent analyst teammate (context:'fresh') for multi-turn analysis.
        gateAllowlistExtra: [spawn_teammate, send_message, interrupt_agent]
        # gateAllowlist: [...]   # override the built-in survival set
        # gateMode: denylist + gatedTools: [bash, edit, write]  # legacy stance
        #
        # GUI 配置（v0.8.4）：卡片渲染六个 volatile 字段（allGoalsMode /
        # taskAgentModel / verifyAgentModel / triageAgentModel / roundsPerSubgoal /
        # maxConcurrentRounds）；volatile 保存落为 profile cordis.patch.yml 的用户
        # patch 行（{id, name, config}，无 insert）并即时生效。roles 已不在卡片上
        # （v0.8.4 起非 volatile，GUI 不暴露）——高级配置直接编辑上方注释示例的
        # config.roles 后重启宿主生效。注意：link: 安装的 src/ schema 只在宿主启动时
        # import——改 schema 后必须重启宿主，面板才会出现新字段。

readme.text:
[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**dsh-cybernetics is a DSH plugin that explicitly designs LLM agent orchestration as a control loop**: the session goal persists as an artifact of the agent's thinking; the task agent acts, the verify agent measures, the triage agent triages, the controller advances between rounds, and the user calibrates the outer loop through conversation — a negative-feedback loop of goal, action, measurement, and calibration.

The protocol takes its name from Wiener's cybernetics: set a goal (setpoint), act, measure the deviation of the output from the goal, and use that deviation to correct the next action. A traditional one-shot prompt is an open-loop system — the goal lives only inside the current prompt, and the burden of measurement falls entirely on the human; this project moves the loop into the system itself, transforming the human from "the author of prompts, one by one" into "the setter of goals and the calibrator of the outer loop." The design rationale is described in the blog post "[Cybernetics Agent — A New Paradigm for AI Applications](https://marchliu.github.io/2026/11/03/cybernetics-agent-new-paradigm)" (in Chinese).

- Full protocol: [docs/protocol.md](docs/protocol.md) (Chinese)
- Evolution history: [docs/CHANGELOG.md](docs/CHANGELOG.md) (Chinese)

```mermaid flowchart TB user["User
（outer-loop calibrator）"] -- "dialog calibration / confirm completion" --> sa sa["session agent
（orchestrator / controller）"] subgraph loop["inner loop: one round (workflows/round.js)"]

| Role | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| **session agent** | Orchestrator (controller): recognizes user input, maintains the goal board, starts/collects/cancels rounds, relays results to the user; never executes tasks itself |
| **controller** | The inter-round state machine in `src/controller.ts`: `startRound`/`foldRound`/`runRound`, advancing the subgoal round by round (task → verify → triage), maintaining the audit log |
| **task agent** | Executor: an independent sub agent with no conversation history, actually executing against the work-order brief, producing a structured delivery report |
| **verify agent** | Measuring instrument: accepts/rejects independently of the executor, producing a structured verdict `{met, criteria, gaps, goalItselfQuestionable}` |
| **triage agent** | Triage: sorts the follow-up leads exposed by the verdict into four categories — auto / defer / reject / human |
| **User** | Outer-loop calibrator: calibrates through conversation (goal revisions go through the session agent's `revise`), adjudicates human-class items, confirms completion — the controller never declares completion by itself |

**goal** is a first-class, persistent state (objective + current subgoal + full work-order brief), built on top of the dsh-goal service; since v0.2 it no longer depends on a goal.md file. The inner loop (task → verify → triage → subgoal correction) iterates automatically while the goal is unchanged, with a per-round cap on consecutive iterations as a backstop; the outer loop (user ↔ session agent) intervenes only when the goal itself is in question — a verdict with `goalItselfQuestionable=true` forbids automatic iteration and forces a return to conversation.

When enabled, injects the "ALL-GOALS MODE ACTIVE" routing protocol: **every user request first creates a goal, then executes**; the session agent is forbidden from completing tasks in place with read tools — even a single-file lookup or one calculation goes through the loop. Simple read-only requests → a single `quick` round; complex analysis / write tasks → progressive multi-round `full` (async `start` + round-by-round `collect` convergence). When the mode is off, the prompt segments and revise behavior are exactly the same as v0.6.

readme.section: Hard gate (`hardGate`, default true — active out of the box; v0.8.10: toggleable on the settings card)
readme.text: **Hot toggle (v0.8.10).** `hardGate` is a **volatile** field: the plugins-page settings card renders a live switch for it. Saving the toggle commits into the running instance and the plugin disposes or (re)installs the gate listeners (assembly strip + dispatch deny + approval relay) immediately — no restart, no plugin reload. A hot false→true re-derives the mode from the current `gateMode` resolution (explicit config wins; otherwise the structural allowlist). The other gate fields (`gateMode`/`gatedTools`/`gateAllowlist`/`gateAllowlistExtra`/`gateApprovalRelay`) remain non-volatile config-document fields; edit those in the profile config document (saving triggers a plugin reload). Deployment nuance: the first time this build ships, the running host still holds the pre-0.8.10 code — restart the host once to load it; after that the toggle is hot (`lib/client.js` needs only a browser refresh).

readme.section: Hard gate (`hardGate`, default true — active out of the box; v0.8.10: toggleable on the settings card)
readme.text: **Effective mode (v0.8.6, default-safe).** When `hardGate` is on and `gateMode` is not configured, the gate runs in **`allowlist`** mode: the top-level session agent keeps only read + conversation + presentation + goal/orchestration verbs (the built-in `DEFAULT_GATE_ALLOWLIST`, extendable via `gateAllowlist` / `gateAllowlistExtra`), and every change-class tool is removed at assembly **and denied at dispatch**. This is the default stance because the old `denylist` default was a trap: it hid only the three names in `gatedTools` (bash/edit/write) and left `bsk_*`, `taskboard_*`, `schedule_*`, `farm_*`, `uno_*`, `ppt_*`, `config_restore` and the rest of the mutation long tail callable — a hard gate in name only. `hardGate: false` installs no gate, exactly as before. An explicitly configured `gateMode` is honored verbatim; the schema has **no default** for `gateMode`, so "unset" stays distinguishable from "explicitly denylist".

readme.section: Hard gate (`hardGate`, default true — active out of the box; v0.8.10: toggleable on the settings card)
readme.text: **Explicit `gateMode: 'denylist'` (residual risk, opt-in).** Only the names in `gatedTools` (default bash/edit/write) are removed. On a top-level agent the following remain available, at least: `bsk_*` (browser automation, including `bsk_session` start/stop), `taskboard_*` writes (create/update/move/comment/checklist/delete), `schedule_*` writes, `farm_*` service lifecycle (start/restart/stop/register/unregister), `uno_*` and `ppt_*` generators, `config_restore`, `subagent`/team spawning, `knowledge_save`, `job_kill` — anything not listed in `gatedTools`, and the set grows with every installed plugin, so a denylist can never be complete. Choose it only if you consciously accept that risk (e.g. the session agent legitimately manages services), and list every mutation tool you need in `gatedTools`. In this mode the injected HARD GATE guidance states the partial stance explicitly (only `gatedTools` removed) and no longer claims that all change tools are structurally unavailable.

readme.section: Hard gate (`hardGate`, default true — active out of the box; v0.8.10: toggleable on the settings card)
readme.text: The task/verify/triage sub agents are never subject to the gate and keep all tools.

The host pins every delegated child (workflow subagent, teammate) to the `never` approval policy at delegation — each ask is deterministically rejected **before any answerer sees it**, so a task agent that needs a sandbox escalation (typically writing outside the session workspace, e.g. `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`) fails without the user ever being asked. With `gateApprovalRelay` on (default, hardGate companion), the plugin:

1. **Unpins the child policy at creation** — on `agent/created` for any delegated child it appends one durable `approval/policy {policy:'ask'}` event to the child session (a later event wins over the delegation-seeded pin, per the host's own fold rule). Without this the approval service short-circuits every ask to `rejected` before any answerer runs.
2. **Re-issues the ask on the top-level session agent** — the plugin registers its `approval/request` answerer **outermost** (`prepend: true`). That is the fix for the last hop: the host's `api-remotes` registers an `approval/request` forwarder at boot, before every user plugin, and the browser's approval answerer claims a child request and awaits a per-session panel that is invisible while the user watches the parent conversation, never calling `next()` — so a relay registered later can never run at all. Running first, the relay resolves the child's **top-level live ancestor** (via the durable `parentSession` chain) and calls the host's own `ApprovalService.request` on it: the request surfaces as the native **Allow once / Reject** panel in the conversation the user is already watching, and is audited as `approval/asked` + `approval/de

**Fallback chain and `unavailable` semantics (v0.8.8)**: if the top-level turn is already closed (a continuable child outliving it), or the native panel answers `unavailable` (no answering client claimed the frame — e.g. the browser never saw it), the relay falls through to a visible `ask_user_question` card ("子代理审批透传") on the same top-level agent — a native `unavailable` is **not** terminal. Only when the question channel is unavailable too does the request end as a terminal `unavailable`. With no live top-level agent at all it falls through to the native chain. Denial semantics stay explicit: a relay failure answers `rejected`, an aborted child run answers `cancelled`, and the child model always receives a real outcome through its approval audit pair (never a silent success).

**Observability / troubleshooting (v0.8.9)**: every relay decision is logged twice — one host-logger line, `cybernetics approval-relay: path=… outcome=… root=… elapsed=…ms` (`console.debug` fallback), and one JSON line appended to `<workspace>/.cybernetics/relay-log.jsonl` (`{ts, root, path, outcome, elapsedMs}`). The file is the acceptance ground truth, readable without host stdout or browser console access. `path` is `native-panel` (the top-level native Allow once / Reject panel), `question-card` (the visible fallback card) or `next-passthrough` (no live top-level agent → native chain). If a child fails fast with `decided unavailable` and **no** entry at all appears in `relay-log.jsonl`, the request never reached the relay (first confirm the host actually reloaded the plugin build); a `path=native-panel outcome=unavailable` entry followed by a `path=question-card` entry means the native frame left the host but no browser claimed it — the user still sees the question card. Note: the question-card fallback resolves the host's `userQuestions` service via `ctx.get` (the inject-free reflective read, same as `dsh-plan-mode`); earlier builds resolved it by plain property access, which c

Set `gateApprovalRelay: false` to keep the strict deterministic-rejection stance (CI/unattended deployments). This field is a hardGate companion and is **non-volatile / config-file maintained**: edit it in the profile config document; a save triggers a plugin reload.

Host-side evidence (file:line), the rejected alternatives and the reproduction are recorded in [docs/approval-relay-investigation.md](docs/approval-relay-investigation.md); `test/relay-host-probe.mjs` re-runs the real cordis waterfall + real `ApprovalService` + this plugin's `apply()` as a regression probe.

readme.section: Append-only goals and the revise decision tree
readme.text: Once a goal exists, it is never modified in place. `revise` is the only goal-changing verb (with required `reason`): it creates a new goal with `parentGoalId` and immediately starts its first round, marks the old goal `superseded` + records `supersededBy`, and appends an audit line per revision to `.cybernetics/revisions-<newGoalId>.jsonl`. readme.section: Append-only goals and the revise decision tree
Append-only goals and the revise decision tree
readme.text: Passing `abortPrevious: true/false` explicitly keeps manual control; every revision's audit line and the `revise` return value carry `abort: {abort, mode: auto|explicit, basis}`.

- `quick`: a single task-agent round whose result is fed straight back, skipping verify/triage, at roughly one-third the cost; the verdict is derived from the task report;
- `full` (default): the complete work → verify → triage loop; delivery only after acceptance passes. The protocol explicitly forbids using quick as a shortcut for changes.

`executor: 'ephemeral' | 'persistent'`, orthogonal to depth. persistent uses a persistent teammate from Agent Teams to perform task work: the first round spawns it via `spawnTeammate(context:'fresh')`, and subsequent rounds deliver only **brief revisions** (added constraints / changed acceptance criteria / narrowed scope; open-ended conversation is forbidden); in a full round the teammate's report serves directly as the task report, while verify/triage still run independently as ephemeral agents — verification never inherits the task narrative. Agent Teams is integrated softly (no injected reflection + exception-safe probing), falling back to ephemeral when unavailable. The goal board persists to `<workspace>/.cybernetics/board-<sessionId>.json` and automatically rehydrates after host restarts, so the "Goals" tab is never emptied.

readme.section: Smart agent model selection (`smartAgentModelSelection`, v0.16, default false)
readme.text: A boolean toggle (volatile, on the settings card; takes effect on the **next goal round** after saving). When on, **every round start** (launch side, before any task/verify/triage child is created) runs a cheap **rule-heuristic classification** over the round's work order (brief → subgoal → objective) and picks a provider/model per role from the host's **live model catalog**. The goal is not to escalate hard tasks — it is to let **simple tasks finish faster and cheaper** (a delete-a-file or git-commit round no longer burns the top-tier model) while genuinely hard work stays on the top tier. All rules live in `src/modelSelection.ts` (pure functions, offline-testable; 中文细则见 README.zh-CN.md 同名小节).

readme.section: Smart agent model selection (`smartAgentModelSelection`, v0.16, default false)
readme.text:
- **Catalog source**: the host's root `llm` service (`listProviders()` / `listModels(provider)`) — the same live directory the settings-card dropdown reads (`buildModelCatalog`'s data source). **No model names are hardcoded**; provider-level failures are isolated and skipped (host parity). Soft probe: a missing service, a Cordis-guarded property read, or a throwing transport degrades to "catalog unavailable".
- **Tier derivation (generic signals, no whitelist)**: **parameter-size tokens** in id/name/description (`8b` ≤12 → light, `30b` ≤40 → mid, `70b` >40 → high) beat **naming tokens** (mini/flash/lite/… → light; opus/ultra/plus/reasoner/… → high); no signal → mid (only the writing class ever picks it). The **session agent's current route is the reference ceiling** (latest requestHeader selection wins, options fallback — matching dsh-subagent's inheritance resolution).
- **Classification → assignment rules** (precedence hard > writing > trivial > standard; **standard never intervenes** — the feature's value is cheapening simple work, not perturbing ordinary work):

readme.section: Smart agent model selection (`smartAgentModelSelection`, v0.16, default false)
readme.text:
- **Merge priority (per role)**: folded **explicit configuration** (roles table + flat settings fields, provider/model either present) **always wins**; smart selection fills only rows with NO explicit provider/model. A row pinning only a reasoning effort is **not re-routed** (the effort is pinned to the inherited route; re-routing would mismatch it). With nothing configured anywhere, smart selection decides every row; a pick identical to the session route stands down to inheritance (identical route + the inherited effort survives).
- **Persistent executor: explicit skip**: `spawnTeammate` accepts no model overrides — the task row is audited as `skipped` with the reason (never a silent miss); verify/triage still run as ephemeral round.js agents on full persistent rounds and remain selectable.
- **quick rounds**: only the task row exists (verify/triage never run; the audit carries the task row alone).
- **Fallback semantics**: catalog unavailable/empty, no suitable model for the class (e.g. nothing lighter than the session model), or a classifier failure — all **silently fall back to plain inheritance**, never erroring or blocking, and every decision (`selected` / `kept-explicit` / `

readme.section: Smart agent model selection (`smartAgentModelSelection`, v0.16, default false)
Smart agent model selection (`smartAgentModelSelection`, v0.16, default false)
readme.text:
- **No reasoning-effort auto-assignment in v0.16**: effort ids are model-dependent; assigning them automatically would need a per-picked-model `resolveModelInfo` probe (an adapter round trip per role per round plus a second failure surface). Smart selection routes only this round; effort stays with the model default or the existing flat effort fields (an explicit model row + effort field pins both).
- **Why rule heuristics instead of one cheap LLM call**: the host does expose a raw completion face (`ctx.llm.prepareCall().stream()` — the session-title-llm pattern), but using it would import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` runtime dependencies (this plugin is deliberately zero-dependency), add a provider round trip BEFORE every round, and open a second failure surface. Deterministic keyword classification costs nothing, is offline-testable, and mis-classifications are visible in the audit and overridable by explicit config — explicit config always winning is the safety floor.

The settings card's「预置方案」dropdown — nine options: **auto-recommend**（根据现有配置自动推荐）plus the eight **vendor registry entries** (OpenAI / Claude / Gemini / DeepSeek / Kimi / Qwen / 火山 Coding Plan / Minimax, full data in `src/modelPresets.ts`). Selecting writes the volatile `presetPlan` field; the plugin resolves each change **one-shot** on `loader/volatile-update` and applies the result to the flat task/verify/triage model + reasoning-effort fields (the same fields the per-agent groups below render) — the outcome lands in the volatile `presetRecommendation` record rendered under the dropdown.

**Session scope (user ruling, highest priority)**: the **session agent is OUT of scope**. The user manages the session model themselves at any time, so preset selection and auto-recommend write ONLY the three sub-agent roles' configuration — `ALLOWED_OP_PATHS` in `src/modelPresets.ts` pins the writable set to exactly the six flat sub-agent fields (three model fields + three effort fields), the recommendation prompt forbids a `session` key in the output, the parser drops one with an explicit note if a model emits it anyway, and every vendor's session suggestion is kept in the registry as REFERENCE data (`variant.session`, shown in the card's session callout as 「由用户自行管理，方案不应用此项」) that can never reach an op.

| action | Semantics |
|---|---|
| `start` | New task: `{action:'start', title, brief}` creates a goal and (by default, in the background) starts its first round |
| `round` | Drives one round, blocking (on an existing goal or a newly created one) |
| `collect` | Folds a completed background round, yielding the controller decision (continue/pause) |
| `revise` | Revises the goal: creates a new goal (append-only), `reason` required, optional objective/title/depth/executor/abortPrevious |
| `cancel` | Aborts a running round (does not change the goal; use when only aborting, not revising) |
| `list` | Shows the state, round counts, and run handles of all goals on this session's goal board |

- **Why "the goal is an artifact of the agent's thinking"**: in the traditional paradigm the human is the controller and the model is the actuator, and the loop exists only in the human's head. Letting the session agent itself organize user input into a persistent goal (the user calibrates the agent through conversation, the agent revises the goal) is what makes the goal a trackable first-class state in the system — the first building block of the feedback loop.
- **Why append-only**: quietly rewriting a goal destroys all the value of "tracking an agent via a goal" — the goal on the tab is no longer the goal you originally set. Identity and history are expressed by the goal chain, just as git expresses history with immutable commits; each revision's reason + audit line is the explicit change record of calibration.
- **Why verify is independent of task**: if the verifier sees the executor's narrative, it degenerates into "checking whether the self-report is self-consistent" instead of "checking whether facts satisfy the goal." **dsh-cybernetics 是一个把多 agent 协作明确设计成控制回路的 DSH 插件**：session goal 作为 agent 的思考产物持久存在，task agent 行动、verify agent 测量、triage agent 分诊，controller 在轮间推进，用户通过对话完成外环校准——目标、行动、测量、校准的负反馈闭环。

这套协议得名于维纳的控制论：设定目标（setpoint）、行动、测量输出与目标的偏差、用偏差修正下一次行动。传统的一次性 prompt 是开环系统——目标只活在当前 prompt 里，测量的责任全在人；本项目把回路搬进系统本身，让人从「逐条 prompt 的作者」变成「目标的设定者与外环的校准者」。设计理念详见博客文章《[Cybernetics Agent——人工智能应用的新范式](https://marchliu.github.io/2026/11/03/cybernetics-agent-new-paradigm)》。

- 协议全文：[docs/protocol.md](docs/protocol.md)
- 演进历史：[docs/CHANGELOG.md](docs/CHANGELOG.md)

```mermaid flowchart TB user["用户
（外环校准者）"] -- "对话校准 / 确认完成" --> sa sa["session agent
（控制器）"] subgraph loop["内环：一轮（workflows/round.js）"]

| 角色 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| **session agent** | 控制器：识别用户输入、维护 goal 板、启动/收取/取消轮、向用户转述；从不亲自执行任务 |
| **controller** | `src/controller.ts` 的轮间状态机：`startRound`/`foldRound`/`runRound`，按轮推进 subgoal（task → verify → triage），维护审计日志 |
| **task agent** | 执行器：无对话历史的独立 sub agent，面向工作委托书（brief）实际执行，产出结构化交付报告 |
| **verify agent** | 测量仪器：独立于执行者验收，产出结构化 verdict `{met, criteria, gaps, goalItselfQuestionable}` |
| **triage agent** | 分诊：对 verdict 暴露的后续线索四分拣 auto / defer / reject / human |
| **用户** | 外环校准者：对话校准（goal 修订经 session agent 的 `revise` 执行）、裁定 human 类目、确认完成——controller 永不自宣完成 |

**goal** 是一等公民的持久状态（objective + 当前 subgoal + 完整工作委托书），构建在 dsh-goal 服务之上，v0.2 起不再依赖 goal.md 文件。内环（task → verify → triage → subgoal 修正）在目标不变时自动迭代，每轮有连续迭代上限兜底；外环（用户 ↔ session agent）只在目标本身有问题时介入——verdict 的 `goalItselfQuestionable=true` 会禁止自动迭代、强制回对话。

readme.section: 全量 goal 模式（`allGoalsMode`，默认 false）
readme.text: 开启后注入「ALL-GOALS MODE ACTIVE」路由协议：**任何用户请求一律先建 goal 再执行**，session agent 禁止用读工具就地完成任务——哪怕单文件查询或一次计算也走回路。简单只读请求 → `quick` 单轮；复杂分析/写任务 → `full` 多轮渐进（`start` 异步启动 + 逐轮 `collect` 收敛）。关闭模式时提示段与 revise 行为与 v0.6 完全一致。

readme.section: 子代理审批透传（`gateApprovalRelay`，默认 true）
readme.text: 宿主在委派边界把每个子代理（workflow 子代理、teammate）的审批策略**钉死为 `never`**——每次审批请求在任何 answerer 看到之前就被确定性拒绝，因此 task agent 需要沙箱越权（典型：写会话工作区之外的路径，如 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）时用户根本没机会被询问。`gateApprovalRelay` 开启时（默认，hardGate 伴随项），插件做两件事：

readme.section: 子代理审批透传（`gateApprovalRelay`，默认 true）
readme.text:
1. **创建时解除子代理策略钉死**——监听 `agent/created`，对委派子代理在其 session 上追加一条持久 `approval/policy {policy:'ask'}` 事件（宿主的折叠规则保证后写事件覆盖委派种下的钉死值）。没有这一步，审批服务会在任何 answerer 运行之前就把请求确定性拒绝成 `rejected`。
2. **在顶层 session agent 上重新发起请求**——插件把 `approval/request` answerer 注册为**最外层**（`prepend: true`），这正是最后一跳的修复点：宿主的 `api-remotes` 在启动时（早于所有用户插件）注册了 `approval/request` 转发器，浏览器审批 answerer 会 claim 子代理请求并等待一张"用户根本看不见"的子会话面板、永不调用 `next()`——因此注册在其后的转发器永远轮不到执行。抢在最外层运行后，插件沿持久 `parentSession` 链找到子代理的**顶层活祖先**，直接调用宿主的 `ApprovalService.request`：请求以原生**允许一次 / 拒绝**面板出现在用户正在看的那个会话里，并在该 session 的 `approval/asked` + `approval/decided` 审计对中留痕。子代理的 tool call id 不向上转发；面板标题（本地化 `displayReason`）会写明是哪个子代理发的请求。

readme.section: 子代理审批透传（`gateApprovalRelay`，默认 true）
readme.text: **回退链与 `unavailable` 语义（v0.8.8）**：若顶层回合已关闭（continuable 子代理比父回合活得久），或原生面板应答 `unavailable`（没有应答端 claim 该请求——例如 frame 根本没被浏览器认领），relay 会继续回退到同一顶层 agent 上**可见的** `ask_user_question` 卡片（「子代理审批透传」）——原生 `unavailable` **不是**终态。仅当问题卡片通道也不可用时才以终态 `unavailable` 结束；完全没有活的顶层 agent 则回落原生应答链。拒绝语义始终显式：转发失败答 `rejected`、子代理已中止答 `cancelled`，子代理模型总能经自己的审批审计对拿到真实结果，绝不会静默成功。

readme.section: 子代理审批透传（`gateApprovalRelay`，默认 true）
readme.text: **可观测性 / 排障（v0.8.9）**：relay 每次决策记录两处——宿主 logger 一行 `cybernetics approval-relay: path=… outcome=… root=… elapsed=…ms`（无 logger 时 `console.debug` 兜底），以及 `<workspace>/.cybernetics/relay-log.jsonl` 追加一条 JSON（`{ts, root, path, outcome, elapsedMs}`）。该文件是验收时的**落盘事实**，无需宿主 stdout 或浏览器 console 即可直接读取。`path` 取值：`native-panel`（顶层原生允许一次/拒绝面板）、`question-card`（可见的回退卡片）、`next-passthrough`（无活顶层 agent → 原生链）。若子代理快速失败且审计为 `decided unavailable` 而 `relay-log.jsonl` **一条记录都没有**，说明请求根本没到 relay（先确认宿主确实重载了插件构建）；若出现 `path=native-panel outcome=unavailable` 后跟 `path=question-card` 两条，说明 frame 离开了宿主但浏览器没有认领——此时用户仍能看到问题卡片。另注：问题卡片回退通过 `ctx.get` 解析宿主的 `userQuestions` 服务（免 inject 的反射式读取，与 `dsh-plan-mode` 同法）；旧构建用普通属性访问解析，而 cordis 对未 inject 的服务属性访问会直接抛错——v0.8.8 真机失败（「卡片从未出现、12ms 内终态 unavailable」）正是这个原因。

readme.section: 子代理审批透传（`gateApprovalRelay`，默认 true）

设 `gateApprovalRelay: false` 可回到严格确定性拒绝的立场（CI/无人值守部署）。该字段是 hardGate 伴随项，属**非 volatile / 配置文件维护**字段：请直接在 profile 配置文档中维护，保存触发插件重载。

readme.section: append-only goals 与 revise 决策树
readme.text:
goal 一经存在不再原地修改。`revise` 是唯一的改目标动词（必填 `reason`）：创建带 `parentGoalId` 的新 goal 并立即启动其第 1 轮，旧 goal 置 `superseded` + 记录 `supersededBy`；每次修订追加审计行到 `.cybernetics/revisions-<新goalId>.jsonl`。v0.7 起 `abortPrevious` 缺省时按自动决策树裁定（纯函数 `decideAbort`，依据 goal 板 running 状态）：

- (a) 旧轮在跑且修订改写目标本身（objective/depth 变化）→ **自动中止旧轮**；
- (b) 旧轮在跑但目标不变（仅 brief/title/role 修正）→ **等待旧轮自然结束**；
- (c) 旧 task agent 已结束 → **直接启动新 goal**。

readme.section: append-only goals 与 revise 决策树
readme.text: 显式传 `abortPrevious: true/false` 保持人工控制；每次修订的审计行与 `revise` 返回值都携带 `abort: {abort, mode: auto|explicit, basis}`。

- `quick`：单 task agent 一轮出结果直接反馈，跳过 verify/triage，成本约 1/3，verdict 由任务报告派生；
- `full`（默认）：完整 工作 → 验证 → 分诊 循环，验收通过才交付。协议明令禁止用 quick 抄近路做变更。

`executor: 'ephemeral' | 'persistent'`，与 depth 正交。persistent 用 Agent Teams 的持久 teammate 执行 task 工作：首轮 `spawnTeammate(context:'fresh')` 投生，后续轮只投递**委托书修订**（新增约束/验收标准变化/范围收窄，禁止开放式对话）；full 轮中 teammate 报告直接作为 task 报告，verify/triage 仍以临时 agent 独立运行——验证不继承任务叙述。软集成 Agent Teams（无注入反射 + 异常安全探测），取不到即回退 ephemeral。goal 板持久化到 `<workspace>/.cybernetics/board-<sessionId>.json`，宿主重启后自动 rehydrate，「目标」页签不清空。

readme.section: 多 goal 板与「目标 / 控制」客户端页签
readme.text: 同一 session 支持多个并发 goal（插件自有 goal 板；dsh-goal 的单槽降级为焦点 goal）。客户端 `lib/client.js` 提供两个会话页签，经插件自有 session 投影 `cyberneticsGoals` 实时推送、就地更新：

readme.section: 多 goal 板与「目标 / 控制」客户端页签
readme.text:
- **「目标 / Goal」**：本会话全部 goal（标题 / 状态徽标 / 第 N 轮 / 当前 subgoal / depth、executor 小标签 / 被取代与修订来源标注），按「未完成在前、已完成在后」两段排序；空板回退 dsh-goal 单 goal 渲染。
- **子智能体会话的「目标」（v0.18）**：workflow 的 task/verify/triage 子会话与 Agent Teams teammate 自身没有 goal 板，页签改为显示**整个 session 的目标页**——沿父链找到最近一个有非空 `cyberneticsGoals` 板的祖先会话（通常就是主会话）并渲染其卡片。父链来自实时的会话列表（`ctx.sessions.list`）：优先 `byId[id].parentId`，缺失时回退该会话所属 catalog 的 `subagentCatalog` 条目，带 visited 防环与 16 跳上限。该模式下还会标出「自己的目标项」——`agents` 包含本会话 id 的 goal（孙代则取最近的命中祖先）：左侧 accent 边框 +「当前」小徽标；首次打开时把它滚动到视野中央（`scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' })`，去重标记落在滚动容器上，板子实时更新不会反复滚动；根会话自板永不自动滚）。「关联智能体」chips 在祖先板下以**板会话**作为 `parentSessionId`（child 的真实父会话）并从该会话的 catalog 读活性，因此随时可跳转到该板会话的其它 agents。自板非空的会话渲染与旧版完全一致（无提示行、无滚动），老宿主没有会话列表存储时保持 v0.18 之前的空态回退。仅客户端改动：宿主重启 + 刷新浏览器后生效。
- **「对话」主页入口（v0.18.1 引入，v0.18.3 起为回主页语义）**：「目标」「控制」两个页签内容的第一行都有一个页签样式的「对话」按钮。「回到主页」式导航：无论在哪个 agent 的「目标 / 控制」页签，点击都回到**主 agent（根会话）**的对话视图——而不是 v0.18.2 那样切到**当前子 agent** 自己的 chat。在根会话上一步直达（`openView('chat', 'cybernetics-home')`）；在子 agent 上是两段式 SPA 跳转，全部走宿主公开 seam：`uiWorkspace.openSession(rootId)` 选中根会话（target = `SessionId | SubagentAddress`），同时向根会话投一条一次性、约 4 s 有效的 home 请求；根会话自己的「目标 / 控制」视图挂载时消费该请求（读即删）并调用它自己的 `open

每个会话头部常驻一枚徽标，一眼可见当前控制模式生效态：**绿点 +「开」** = 生效中（本会话 `/cybernetics on` 显式 override，或继承全局 `allGoalsMode`），**灰点 +「关」** = 生效关闭，**暗「…」** = 投影/配置尚未加载（加载态而非错误态）。tooltip 注明生效来源（「本会话显式设置」vs「继承全局配置」）。点击徽标即切换——走的正是斜杠菜单同款 `/cybernetics on|off` 命令通道（宿主 `commands.execute`，不新增服务端 API），写入的是同一条 durable 会话事件、投影实时回流。控制模式生效时，输入框上方显示一条细提示条说明下一次输入的去向，文案随 volatile `inputPolicy` 变化（insert →「新输入将作为外环控制即时插入当前回合」；queue →「新输入将排队为下一轮输入」）。数据联接：会话投影 `cyberneticsMode`（{override: true|false|null}）+ ConfigForm 里的全局 volatile `allGoalsMode`，客户端按与服务端 `resolveMode`（src/sessionMode.ts）一致的规则就地联接——投影只在会话事件时重发布，全局 volatile 翻转无法抵达服务端算好的生效值，而两个输入在客户端都是响应式的。文案双语（zh/en）。仅客户端改动：宿主重启（客户端模块图启动时构建）+ 刷新浏览器后生效。

`src/index.ts` 导出 schemastery `Config` schema，它决定宿主设置传输层服务与接受哪些字段（仅 `.volatile()` 字段）；卡片 UI 本身由 `lib/client.js` 绘制，注册 `plugins.item` / `plugins.bundle.config` / `plugins.row.config` 三个席位（bundle 详情页与组件详情页都能配置）。**这张卡片是本插件设置在 GUI 中的唯一 surface**：宿主「插件」页对插件配置完全交给 slot 卡片渲染、自身一个字段都不画，@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings 只提供 `configForms` 服务（传输层）而非通用字段渲染器——因此 v0.8.1 起卡片渲染全部 volatile 字段的可编辑控件（v0.17 起共 16 个）：全目标模式开关、硬门开关、**智能选择 Agent 配置开关**、**预置方案下拉框**及其推荐请求模型字段、task/verify/triage 各自的「模型 + 思考强度」配对分组、子目标轮数上限与并行轮数上限数字框。`roles` 表**不在卡片上**（v0.8.4）：在 GUI 里手工编辑 JSON 对象对用户不友善，roles 改为非 volatile——面板不再服务也不接受写入——改经 profile 配置 yaml 直接配置（见下文「roles 高级配置」小节）。volatile 字段保存即时生效（loader 直接提交进运行实例，不 remount）；非 volatile 字段保存触发插件行 remount（需宿主重载）。写入落点是用户 patch 行（profile `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `{id, name, config}` 行）。

- **扁平字段**：`taskAgentModel` / `verifyAgentModel` / `triageAgentModel`（「provider/model」或裸模型名，volatile）；**留空 = 与 session agent 一致**（继承语义）。保存后下一轮 goal 即生效，无需重载。triage 角色读 task/verify 结果输出本轮收敛决策（met/continue/human-input 等）；quick 轮完全跳过 verify/triage，`triageAgentModel` 只在 full 轮生效。v0.8.3 起三个字段为下拉加持：`<datalist>` 由宿主实时模型目录驱动（`remote.session.modelCatalog`——与官方「子智能体」设置页同一数据源，`llm/adapters-updated` 事件时刷新），同时保留手工输入（datalist 输入框接受任意文本）。配置值已不在目录中（如该模型订阅被删除）时，卡片显示「不可用——运行时将回退到 session agent 模型」警告并附一键**清除**（显式 unset 写入——绝不静默改写已存配置）；运行时回退即 v0.8.0 的 `callRoleAgent`（AGENT_START `no subagent provider registered` 覆盖 provider 被删；模型级「model not found / unknown model」报错已并入 v0.8.3 的可用性模式表）。
- **roles 表**：按角色覆盖 sub agent 模型（`default`/`verify`/`triage` 固定槽位 + 任意命名任务角色）。v0.8.4 起属高级配置，直接编辑 profile 配置 yaml 维护，不再上设置卡片——见下方「roles 高级配置」小节：

```yaml
- id: dsh-cybernetics
  config:
    roles:
      default: { provider: zai-coding-cn, model: glm-5.3 }

- **调用级回退（v0.8）**：为某角色设定的模型无法正常调用时——限额/quota 耗尽、网络不可达、provider 报错等**可用性失败**——不再让整个 goal 轮失败：`workflows/round.js` 撤销该角色的 provider/model 覆盖，以 **session agent** 的模型配置重试该角色的子 agent 一次。判定信号来自 workflow runtime（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc`）`agent()` hook 的错误类型/消息：抛出的 `WorkflowError`（`AGENT_START` 恒算；`AGENT_RESULT`/无 code 错误需消息命中 quota/鉴权/5xx/网络/provider 模式），或返回 `null`（runtime 把子 run `stopReason ≠ "completed"` —— LLM 调用中途失败最常见的形态——压成 null 且不透传原因；仅当配置了覆盖时重试）。**逻辑失败永不换模型**：task agent 正常交付 `done=false` 报告、verify 返回未达成 verdict 都原样流转；非可用性错误（schema/option/cap 守卫错误）原样上抛。每次回退记录进轮结果的 `fallbacks` 数组（`{role, from, trigger, reason}`），narrate 进 `workflow/log`，随 `.cybernetics/round-*.json` 审计日志落盘，并追加进 `cybernetics` 工具结果的决策 note。配置语义向后兼容：留空 = 继承 session agent（无回退必要）；已配置 = 优先用配置模型，可用性失败时回退。`workflows/round.js` 改动热生效。

readme.section: 智能选择 Agent 配置（`smartAgentModelSelection`，v0.16，默认 false）
readme.text: 二元开关（volatile，设置卡片布尔开关，保存后**下一轮 goal** 生效）：开启后，**每轮启动时**（launch 侧，早于任何 task/verify/triage 子 agent 的创建）按本轮任务内容（brief → subgoal → objective）做一次**规则启发式分类**，并从宿主**实时可用模型目录**为每个角色自动选择 provider/model。目标不是给困难任务预警，而是**让简单任务更快、更省资源地完成**（删文件、git 提交这类轮不再占用顶配模型），困难任务仍落顶配。规则与选择逻辑全部在 `src/modelSelection.ts`（纯函数，离线可测）。

readme.section: 智能选择 Agent 配置（`smartAgentModelSelection`，v0.16，默认 false）
readme.text:
- **模型目录来源**：宿主根级 `llm` 服务的 `listProviders()` / `listModels(provider)`——与设置卡片下拉同一份实时目录（`buildModelCatalog` 的数据源），**绝不硬编码模型名**；provider 级失败隔离跳过（与宿主同策略）。软探测：服务缺失 / 属性读取被 Cordis 守卫拦截 / 传输抛错 → 目录视为不可用。
- **档位推导（generic 信号，非白名单）**：模型 id/名称/描述里的**参数量 token**（`8b` ≤12 → 轻量，`30b` ≤40 → 中档，`70b` >40 → 顶配）优先于**命名 token**（mini/flash/lite/… → 轻量；opus/ultra/plus/reasoner/… → 顶配）；无信号 → 中档（仅写作类会选中）。**session agent 当前路由 = 顶配参照**（requestHeader 最新选择优先，options 兜底，与 dsh-subagent 的继承解析一致）。
- **分类 → 分配规则**（优先级 hard > writing > trivial > standard；standard **完全不介入**——本功能的价值在省简单任务的钱，不在扰动常规任务）：

readme.section: 智能选择 Agent 配置（`smartAgentModelSelection`，v0.16，默认 false）
readme.text:
- **合并优先级（逐角色）**：折叠后的**显式配置**（roles 表 + 设置面板平面字段，provider/model 任一存在）**恒优先**，智能选择只填补没有显式 provider/model 的行；只钉了思考强度档位（effort-only）的行**不换路由**（档位钉在继承路由上，改路由会失配）。全部未配置时智能选择全权决定；选定模型恰为 session 路由时也保持继承（等效路由 + 保留继承档位）。
- **persistent executor 显式跳过**：`spawnTeammate` 不接受模型覆盖——persistent 轮的 task 行审计为 `skipped` 并写明原因（绝不静默失效）；verify/triage 在 full 持久轮仍走 round.js 照常可选。
- **quick 轮**：只有 task 行（verify/triage 不存在，审计也只产 task 一行）。
- **回退语义**：目录不可用/为空、该分类无合适模型（如部署里没有比 session 更轻的模型）、分类器异常——一律**静默回退现有继承行为**，不报错、不阻断，且每行决策（selected / kept-explicit / kept-inherit / skipped）连同理由写入审计。
- **审计**：每次选择的输入摘要（字符数 + 前 100 字符）、分类结果、目录规模、逐角色决策（含 picked 路由与理由）随轮记录落盘——`.cybernetics/round-<goalId>-<N>.json` 的 `smartSelection` 字段（仿 v0.8 `fallbacks` 先例；round.js 从 args 原样回传，persistent 路径经 executor.ts 同步携带），`collect`/`round` 的工具结果同样可见。示例：

readme.text:
```json
{
  "smartSelection": {
    "enabled": true,
    "taskClass": "trivial",

- **v0.16 不自动分配思考强度**：档位 id 是模型相关的，自动分配需逐选中模型 `resolveModelInfo` 探测（每轮每角色一次适配器 I/O + 额外失败面）；智能选择本轮只选路由，档位留给模型默认或现有平面 effort 字段（显式模型行 + effort 字段可精确固定）。
- **为什么用规则启发式而不是一次廉价模型调用**：宿主确有裸补全面（`ctx.llm.prepareCall().stream()`，session-title-llm 模式），但要求引入 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 运行时依赖（本插件刻意零依赖）、每轮启动前多一次 provider 往返与整条失败面。确定性关键词分类零成本、离线可测，误分类可经审计发现并由显式配置覆盖——显式配置恒优先是安全底线。

设置卡片新增「预置方案」下拉，共 9 个选项：**根据现有配置自动推荐** + 八家**厂商方案**（OpenAI / Claude / Gemini / DeepSeek / Kimi / Qwen / 火山 Coding Plan / Minimax，全量数据见 `src/modelPresets.ts`）。选择写入 volatile `presetPlan` 字段；插件在 `loader/volatile-update` 上对每次变更**一次性（one-shot）解析**，把结果应用到 task/verify/triage 的扁平模型 + 思考强度字段（即下方各角色分组渲染的字段），结果记录写入 volatile `presetRecommendation`，在下拉框下方渲染。

**作用范围（用户裁定，最高优先）**：**session agent 不在本功能范围内**——session 模型由用户随时自行调整，因此选择方案与自动推荐只写三个子 agent 角色的配置：`src/modelPresets.ts` 的 `ALLOWED_OP_PATHS` 把可写字段结构性地钉死为六个扁平子 agent 字段（三个模型字段 + 三个思考强度字段）；推荐 prompt 明令输出只允许 task/verify/triage 三个键、禁止 session 键（解析器对模型万一直出的 session 键丢弃并显式注明）；各厂商的 session 推荐仅作参考数据保留在注册表（`variant.session`），卡片上常驻「session 由用户自行管理，方案不应用此项」提示，永远不会进入任何写入。

- **厂商方案（数据驱动，`status: 'ready'`）**：每厂商含逐角色模型 + 思考强度 token（异构：OpenAI/Minimax 五档 low/medium/high/xhigh/max、DeepSeek thinking 开关、其余模型默认）、可升级档、可用性 fallback、逐角色 rationale、厂商备注（⚠️ 注意事项——如 Qwen 的「verify 绝不用 Turbo（幻觉共振）」、Kimi 的避开退役 K2、DeepSeek 的「成本不应成为降级 verify 的理由」）与**多变体**（Claude 常规/高要求，Qwen A/B/C，DeepSeek 仅本家/verify 外置，Kimi 长期组合/最高验收质量，火山 A/B）。选择方案应用其**默认变体**（第一个）；结果记录披露所应用变体并列出其余变体。厂商原生模型 id 逐字应用——部署目录中不存在的 id 会显示卡片不可用警告，轮内可用性 fallback（v0.8）保证轮次存活。
- **自动推荐（v0.18.2 起 = session agent 交办，用户裁定）**：选择 auto 时插件**不发起任何独立 LLM 调用、不新起任何子 agent**（v0.17.2 及之前的「一次一次性 LLM 调用 + 推荐所用模型配置项」已删除——另起一次调用等于把上下文重复提交一遍，时间与经济性都不合理）。现在的流程：插件探测实时目录（`probeCatalogOptions`，与智能选择同源），把推荐交办单——内嵌目录（唯一可选来源）、跨厂商通用原则（verify 档位不低于 task；verify/task 跨代际跨家族保持独立；verify 不能过度自信；省成本先压 task/triage、verify 最后动且成本不是降级 verify 的理由；triage 轻量）、当前角色配置与全部厂商方案（仅作参考）——经插件注册的 `preset_recommend` 工具交给 session agent，并在卡片写入 `pending` 记录、向在线 session agent 投递一条 steer/followup 提醒。session agent 在**自己的上下文中**读取目录、给出 task/verify/triage 的答案，再次调用该工具提交；插件只负责校验（逐字命中目录；逐角色 `reasoningEffort` 经 `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo` 校验，不支持时降为模型默认并注明）与写入。session agent 未作答时卡片保持 pending；答案不可用（未命中目录/不可解析/零选择）时降级为带原因的 `degraded` 记录并回执给 session agent 修正重交——不应用任何更改、不阻塞任何轮次。该工具在

session agent 在会话内通过 `cybernetics` 工具（`toolName` 可配置）驱动回路，隐式触发提示段（`implicitTrigger: false` 可关）会指导它不等显式要求就按输入分类协议调用：

| action | 语义 |
|---|---|
| `start` | 新任务：`{action:'start', title, brief}` 建 goal 并（默认后台）启动第 1 轮 |
| `round` | 阻塞式驱动一轮（对既有 goal 或新建 goal） |
| `collect` | 折叠已完成的后台轮，得到 controller 决策（continue/pause） |
| `revise` | 修订目标：创建新 goal（append-only），`reason` 必填，可选 objective/title/depth/executor/abortPrevious |
| `cancel` | 中止在跑的轮（不改目标；只中止不改目标时用） |
| `list` | 查看本会话 goal 板全部 goal 的状态、轮次与运行句柄 |
配套审计：每轮结构化结果落 `.cybernetics/round-<goalId>-<N>.json`；修订落 `.cybernetics/revisions-<新goalId>.jsonl`；goal 板快照落 `.cybernetics/board-<sessionId>.json`。

- **为什么「goal 是 agent 的思考产物」**：传统范式里人是控制器、模型是执行器，回路只存在于人的脑子里。让 session agent 自己把用户输入整理为持久 goal（用户通过对话校准 agent，agent 修订 goal），目标才成为系统里可跟踪的一等公民状态——反馈回路的第一块积木。
- **为什么 append-only**：目标被悄悄改写，会摧毁「经 goal 跟踪 agent」的全部价值——页签上的目标不再是你当初设定的目标。身份与历史由 goal 链表达，正如 git 用不可变 commit 表达历史；每次修订的 reason + 审计行就是校准的显式变更记录。
- **为什么 verify 独立于 task**：验证者若看执行者的叙述，会退化成「检查自述是否自洽」而非「检查事实是否满足目标」。测量仪器必须独立于被测对象——协议的核心不变量：**上下文是被配给的，不是被继承的**（task 只拿委托书、verify 只拿 goal + 报告 + 证据、triage 只拿 verdict，永不用 `context: 'fork'`）。持久的是身份和 goal 边界，不是会话历史。
- **为什么硬门**：早期的「session agent 不亲自执行」只是提示里的劝告，模型看到琐碎任务就会内联干完。硬门在装配期物理移除执行工具，把劝告变成结构——控制者的全部产出是 goal 和 brief（信息），执行者的全部产出是对世界的改变（行动），可观测性与可控性的边界划在角色上，不依赖模型自觉。
- **振荡防御与升级路径**：每轮连续迭代上限是对「反馈延迟过大导致振荡」的工程化防御；triage 的 human 分拣是控制器为「不可自动处理的扰动」预留的升级路径；`goalItselfQuestionable` 在结构上区分「方向错了」和「执行得不好」。

readme.section: 与 DSH 现有机制的关系
readme.text:
- **goal**：不替代——dsh-goal 仍是 durable setpoint 与续跑驱动；本插件是它的工作回路。
- **workflow**：每轮就是一次 `ctx.workflowEngine.start()` run；不新增独立控制机制（构建在 `dsh-workflow` 之上）。
- **完成确认**：controller 永不自宣完成、不代改 goal phase；`met` 也只暂停等用户。

1. **settings 写入的宿主缺陷**：如「插件页配置」一节所述，该运行时上卡片保存可能被宿主在落盘前拒绝（上游 [#12045](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh/discussions/12045)）；workaround：重启宿主 + 强刷浏览器，或手工 patch 行 + 重启。
2. **volatile 与非 volatile 字段的保存语义差异**：volatile 字段（`allGoalsMode`、v0.8.10 起的 `hardGate`、`taskAgentModel`、`verifyAgentModel`、`triageAgentModel`、`roundsPerSubgoal`、`maxConcurrentRounds`）保存即时生效、不 remount；非 volatile 字段（v0.8.4 起的 `roles`、`gateMode`、`gatedTools`、`gateAllowlist*`、`gateApprovalRelay`、`toolName`、`implicitTrigger`）保存触发插件行 remount，需宿主重载完成。且宿主设置表单只服务也只接受 volatile 路径——运行中宿主的 schema 过旧时，volatile 写也会被拒（重启即愈）。
3. **`link:` 安装注意事项**：客户端 bundle 的注册 id 必须等于 package.json 的 `name`（`@mars.liu/dsh-cybernetics`）；loader 行 id 可用短名 `dsh-cybernetics`。插件需挂在本 profile 的**顶层** loader entries（客户端扫描只枚举顶层行）；`src/` 改动需宿主重载、`lib/` 改动需重启宿主 + 刷新浏览器。
4. 其他协议边界（硬门在装配层不在执行层、dsh-goal 焦点槽不随 superseded 迁移等）见 [docs/protocol.md](docs/protocol.md) 各「已知边界」小节。
